title: Using Your Cart in iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r9nd95e

steps.title: Manage Datasets in Cart
steps.instruction: Add, view, and remove datasets of interest within the iMicrobe cart.

substeps.instruction: Add data of interest to the personal cart using the 'Add to cart' button.
Access and explore selected datasets by clicking the Cart icon on the top right of the screen.
Remove datasets from the cart using the 'Remove' button.

steps.title: Save and Retrieve Carts
steps.instruction: Name, store, and manage saved carts for future use.

substeps.instruction: Name and save the cart using the 'save as' button at the top of the screen.
Retrieve a stored cart via the dropdown menu at the top of the screen.
Copy the content of a saved cart to the current cart using the 'Copy to current' button.
Delete or empty a saved cart using the 'delete' and 'empty' buttons respectively.

steps.title: Share Saved Cart
steps.instruction: Generate a public link to share a saved cart with other iMicrobe users using the 'share' button on the top of the screen.
